scope: CLI-authorized dynamic-recipient ASCII message flow; offline verification only
authorization: User explicitly confirmed each CLI instruction authorizes its specified recipient and content without another approval; retain stop-on-ambiguity, primary-screen guards and no duplicate sending
task_parser: delivery_task.py; deterministic explicit single-message Chinese instruction syntax, not unrestricted natural-language understanding
recipient_source: current CLI instruction; no real contact hardcoded in active runner
payload_scope: 1-80 safe ASCII characters; Unicode message rejected before device connection
coverage: explicit task required; dry-run does not load device/model dependencies
mock complete flow performs exactly one scoped input and one send without input()
recipient mismatch, group, ambiguity, nonempty draft and changed editor stop
known partial client dump permits one same-target read-only reobservation
input and send reserved durably before dispatch; transport uncertainty not retried
pending recipient cannot be bypassed with a new request ID
old outgoing message and sending/failed states do not count as new success
insufficient verification budget stops before input or send
snapshot_changes: Anonymous nickname substitution in historical experimental source/docs; new autonomous modules, auto entry, and scoped read-only reobservation flag
result_semantics: model-confirmed new outgoing bubble plus machine checks, not account authentication or recipient delivery proof
